The 0 side of [[The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed]] (PC-E1, March 2026), marked “E1”: Players Committee card image from the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/thefirstorderreigns.gif thefirstorderreigns.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026); replaced by the “E2” card 11 May 2026.

Edits: none. The image is uploaded unchanged (the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name; uploaded as .png).
